subject: GENERATE statement
notes: (kb/Work PB1129, wave 1005 A). Step c) of the page advance - 'If the associated report description entry contains a CODE clause with an identifier operand, the identifier is evaluated' (cite.py --check 14.9.16.4 OK 6) c)) - is CobolReport.EvaluateCode, called from AdvancePage after the physical advance (b) and before PAGE-COUNTER (d), LINE-COUNTER (e) and the page heading (f). Steps a, b, d, e, f were already witnessed. pb1129_rd_code_identifier pins the order: the page footing printed by the advance carries the code in force BEFORE the evaluation (BPF while WS-CD already holds C), and the new page's heading and detail carry the value evaluated at c) (CPH, CD3).
